ITA-9.6.7 ṣaṭ-yantraprakāraḥ षट् -यन्त्रप्रकारः
Six types of blunt instruments
The sixfold classification of blunt surgical instruments.

ITA-1.9.1  padārthāḥ षट्-पदार्थाः
Six ontological categories of an object
The object of experience is subdivided into six fundamental categories: generality (samanyam), particularity (vishesham), substance (dravyam), quality (gunaḥ), action (karma), and inherence (samavayaḥ).

ITA-4.6.6 kriyākālaḥ/ṣaṭkriyākālaḥ क्रियाकालः/षट्क्रियाकालः
Stages of disease manifestation and management
A comprehensive term for the six prominent stages in disease management indicating the stepwise progression of its pathogenesis.
